name_in_paper: real time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays

evidence.quote: Nasopharyngeal aspirates were collected by trained site investigators using the same standardized protocol utilized in a previous cohort study of children with bronchiolitis ( 4 , 20 ). All sites used the same collection equipment (Medline Industries, Mundelein, IL) and collected the samples within 24 hours of hospitalization. The nasopharyngeal sample was added to transport medium, immediately placed on ice and then stored at −80°C. Frozen samples were shipped in batches on dry ice to Baylor College of Medicine, where they were tested for: 1) 17 respiratory viruses (e.g., respiratory syncytial virus [RSV], rhinovirus) by using real time polymerase chain reaction (PCR) assays ( 4 , 20 , 21 )

16s ribosomal gene sequencing assay.readouts: bacterial 16S V4 sequences for microbiota composition and taxonomic profiles

evidence.section: 16S rRNA Gene Sequencing and Compositional Analysis
evidence.quote: The 16S rDNA V4 region was amplified by PCR and sequenced in the MiSeq platform (Illumina; SanDiego, CA) using the 2×250 bp paired-end protocol yielding pair-end reads that overlap almost completely. The primers used for amplification contain adapters for MiSeq sequencing and single-end barcodes allowing pooling and direct sequencing of PCR products ( 22 , 23 ).
